For Russian employers

Legal route mapping, documents and post-hire compliance for foreign staff.

Define the hiring route before filing

The process depends on nationality, immigration status, job location, the employer’s role and the contract. We review those facts before identifying possible permits, exemptions and filing steps.

Where we can help

Permits and visas

Assess the applicable route for engaging foreign staff, work authorisation, invitations and visas, including exceptions.

Ministry notifications

Check the event, competent office, current form, filing method and deadline; organise evidence of submission.

Frequently asked questions

Does every employer need the same permit?

No single route fits every worker. The legal category and any exemptions must be assessed before filing.

Can one notification cover a whole group?

We check the current requirement for each contract and event, then retain proof of the filing. Do not assume a group filing is sufficient.

Do you guarantee permits or visas?

No. Government authorities decide applications. Our work is limited to the agreed legal scope and risk advice.

Starting points: Federal Law No. 115-FZ, Article 13 and Ministry of Internal Affairs Order No. 290 of 12 May 2026. Current versions and applicability require checking for each matter.
